parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT s.uniqueref, s.sentrix_id::text, s.chiptype_ref, s.care_site_ref
FROM scans s
WHERE s.status_concept_ref = 29
AND s.sentrix_id::text IN ({{ $json.barkodlar }})

parameters.command: =FOLDER="/volume1/ALLDATA/Scans/{{ $json.sentrix_id }}/"; SENTRIX="{{ $json.sentrix_id }}"; POSITION="{{ $json.position }}"; GREEN=$(ls "${FOLDER}${SENTRIX}_${POSITION}_Grn.idat" 2>/dev/null | head -1); RED=$(ls "${FOLDER}${SENTRIX}_${POSITION}_Red.idat" 2>/dev/null | head -1); TOTAL_RESCAN=$(ls "${FOLDER}"Metrics_old*.txt 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); POS_SCAN_COUNT=0; for f in "${FOLDER}"Metrics.txt "${FOLDER}"Metrics_old*.txt; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; if grep -q "${POSITION}_" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then POS_SCAN_COUNT=$((POS_SCAN_COUNT + 1)); fi; done; if [ "$POS_SCAN_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then POS_RESCAN=$((POS_SCAN_COUNT - 1)); else POS_RESCAN=0; fi; IS_RESCANNED=0; if [ "$POS_SCAN_COUNT" -gt 1 ]; then if grep -q "${POSITION}_" "${FOLDER}Metrics.txt" 2>/dev/null; then IS_RESCANNED=1; fi; fi; echo "{\"green_idat_path\":\"$GREEN\",\"red_idat_path\":\"$RED\",\"total_rescan_count\":$TOTAL_RESCAN,\"position_rescan_count\":$POS_RESCAN,\"is_rescanned\":$IS_RESCANNED}"

const PATOLOJI_MAP = {
  "Goztepe-SH": "Goztepe-SH-Patoloji",
  "Etlik-SH": "Etlik-SH-Patoloji",
  "Umraniye-EAH": "Umraniye-EAH-Patoloji",
  "Istanbul-EAH": "Istanbul-EAH-Patoloji",
  "Marmara-Pendik-EAH": "Marmara Patoloji",
  "Istinye-GHDM": "Istinye-Patoloji",
};

const items = $input.all();
const results = [];

for (const item of items) {
  const row = { ...item.json };

  // Trim all string fields
  for (const key of Object.keys(row)) {
    if (typeof row[key] === 'string') {
      row[key] = row[key].trim();
    }
  }

  // Filter: Örnek boş veya "BOŞ" ise atla
  const ornek = (row['Örnek'] || '').toUpperCase();
  if (!ornek || ornek === 'BOŞ') continue;

  // Filter: Kurum "BOŞ" veya "-" ise atla
  const kurum = row.Kurum || '';
  if (kurum.toUpperCase() === 'BOŞ' || kurum === '-') continue;

  // Kurum mapping
  if (kurum in KURUM_MAP) {
    let mapped = KURUM_MAP[kurum];
    if (mapped && (row['Çip'] || row['Cip'] || '').toUpperCase().includes('EPIC') && mapped in PATOLOJI_MAP) {
      mapped = PATOLOJI_MAP[mapped];
    }
    row.Kurum = mapped;
  }

  results.push({ json: row });
}

return results;
